fnol_text: My name is Priya O'Connell and I live at 141 Kestrel Avenue, Ashland, OR 97539. You can reach me on (555) 480-2550 or priya.oconnell@example.com. On 10 April 2023 another car pulled out of a side road and hit my front passenger side. The other driver, Mateo Mbeki, admitted they didn't see me. Policy MT-2023-00146. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car. I assume this is covered under my policy?

adjuster_notes.text: Called Dr O'Connell on (555) 480-2550 to acknowledge the claim. Priya confirmed the loss date as 10 April 2023.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Anika Ferreira gave a statement by phone.
Third-party driver Mateo Mbeki reports lower back strain and attended Riverside Medical Center. Priya reports a mild concussion.
